subject: API integration down

subject: API - still broken
body: Nothing's changed since yesterday's ticket. This is now blocking two days of reporting.

subject: Exports - no fix yet
body: Still no export files landing this morning. This needs to be resolved before EOD.

subject: API errors back too

body: Admin panel is unresponsive when trying to update user roles. Nothing's loading past the spinner.

subject: API down again - February
body: Same API problem as last October. Whatever the fix was clearly didn't stick.

body: This is the third API ticket in a matter of days. We need a permanent fix, not another patch.

subject: Exports empty again
body: Exports coming back empty again, months after the last time. Getting tired of reporting the same thing.

subject: Admin panel locked out

subject: Dashboard tiles broken

body: Same day as the dashboard issue, report builder crashes when I try to duplicate an existing report.

subject: Alerts not firing, again
body: Alerts have gone silent again. This keeps happening every few months without a lasting fix.

subject: API errors - same week
body: API is also acting up this week, on top of everything else. Not a good stretch.

subject: Seats page timing out
body: Trying to add two new seats and the admin page just times out repeatedly.

subject: Dashboard loading issue returns
body: Dashboard tiles blank again, same symptom as August. We've reported this enough times now that it should be a known issue.

subject: Dashboard broken again

subject: API error next day
body: Now the API's throwing errors too. Two issues in two days, not great.

subject: Admin page won't save role change
body: Tried changing a user's role three times, keeps reverting. Please fix.

subject: Export download corrupted
body: Downloaded export file won't open, says it's corrupted. Tried twice.

subject: Alerts silent
body: No alerts fired yesterday despite an obvious threshold breach. Second day running into problems.

subject: API timing out
body: API calls timing out constantly today. Third module issue this week.

subject: Can't remove old user
body: Trying to remove a former employee's seat, admin page just spins.

subject: Report builder error on export
body: Report builder throws an error the moment I try to export the finished report.

subject: Connector won't reconnect
body: Data connector disconnected overnight and won't reauthorise, just fails silently.

subject: Seats page broken again
body: Same admin panel problem from last year is back. Can't edit user roles.

subject: Alerts not triggering
body: Alerts gone quiet again, exact same symptom as July last year.

subject: Report builder crashing
body: Report builder keeps crashing on save today, on top of the alerts issue.

subject: Export files empty
body: Exports coming back blank now too. Everything's breaking at once this week.

subject: Alerts still not working
body: Second alerts ticket today, still nothing fixed from this morning.

subject: Exports broken, again
body: Same export problem as February. We keep hitting the same wall.

subject: Connector down
body: Connector's down again, few days after the export issue. Feels constant lately.

subject: Alerts silent, third time
body: Third time this year reporting silent alerts. Please find the actual cause.

subject: Dashboard blank tiles
body: Dashboard tiles blank again same day as the alerts issue. Bad week all round.

subject: Connector still unreliable
body: Connector dropped again. This keeps happening every couple of months, always the same one.

subject: Export formatting for board pack
body: The quarterly export drops our currency formatting entirely once it hits Excel. Would like it preserved for the board pack.

subject: Alert threshold hard to configure
body: Setting a percentage-based alert threshold isn't obvious in the UI, took a few tries to get it right. Might be worth a short guide.

subject: Dashboard refresh lag
body: Dashboard data seems to lag about an hour behind the source system. Is that expected with our current connector schedule?

subject: New seat missing default permissions
body: New seat we added this week doesn't have the standard viewer permissions the rest of the team has by default.

subject: Seat permission template question
body: Following on from Tero's ticket in November, is there a way to set a default permission template for new seats going forward?

subject: Alert emails delayed
body: Alert notification emails are arriving roughly 20 minutes after the actual trigger. Not breaking anything but worth a look.

subject: Connector credentials need re-entering monthly
body: We have to re-enter the ERP connector credentials about once a month even though nothing's changed on our side. Minor annoyance but recurring.

subject: Bulk role update needed
body: Need to update permissions for about 15 users at once ahead of a reorg. Is bulk editing possible or does it have to be one by one?

subject: Connector schema mismatch after source update
body: Our source system updated its schema and the connector is now dropping a field silently instead of erroring. Took us a while to notice.

subject: API response missing new field
body: The API response is missing a field that's present in the UI export for the same report. Inconsistent between the two.

subject: API - same field issue elsewhere
body: Following up on the missing field from June, turns out it's missing from a second endpoint too. Might be a wider gap in the schema.

subject: Connector reauth prompt too frequent
body: Getting prompted to reauthorise the ERP connector more often than usual over the past couple of weeks.

subject: Role template still not available
body: Checking in on whether default permission templates for new seats, raised back in January, are on the roadmap at all.

subject: Seat license count unclear
body: Our invoice shows more licensed seats than the admin panel lists as active. Could someone reconcile the two?

subject: Dashboard export button missing
body: The export-to-PDF button that used to be on the dashboard view seems to have disappeared after the last update.

subject: Export button back - new issue
body: Good news, the export button is back. Different problem now though, the PDF it generates cuts off the right-most column.

subject: API call count higher than expected
body: Noticed our API call volume nearly doubled last month without a change on our side. Wanted to flag before it affects our usage tier.

subject: Question re: seat role assignment
body: Hi, we're onboarding four new analysts this month and I'd like to assign them Viewer access to specific dashboard folders only, without giving them edit rights across the whole workspace. Is there a way to scope seat permissions at the folder level, or do we need to create a separate group for this? Also keen to know if seat changes take effect immediately or need a sync on our end. Thanks, Astrid

subject: Alert notifications not reaching all subscribed users
body: Following up separately from the seat question last week - we've noticed the weekly revenue alert we configured is only reaching two of the five subscribed users, even though all five show as active recipients in the alert settings. We've checked spam folders and email addresses are correct. Could you take a look at why delivery seems inconsistent? Would like this fixed before next week's report cycle if possible.

subject: Scheduled export dropping columns
body: The scheduled export we run each Monday for the finance team has started dropping the last two columns (region and cost centre) from the CSV output, though the on-screen report still shows them correctly. This is the second formatting hiccup we've had this quarter and it's causing real headaches for the team who rebuild the file manually before circulating it. Could someone look into what changed on the export template side?

subject: Connector sync failing overnight - Salesforce
body: Our Salesforce connector has failed silently three nights running, pulling stale data into the dashboards each morning without any error notification. We only caught it because the numbers looked off in yesterday's stand-up. As a stopgap the team has started re-exporting the raw data into Excel each morning to cross-check before we present anything internally. Would appreciate a fix and, ideally, a way to get proactive alerts when a sync fails rather than finding out by chance.

subject: Seat permissions still not scoping correctly
body: Coming back to the folder-level permissions setup from September - it turns out the scoping only holds for a few weeks before newly added dashboards default back to visible-to-all for the affected seats. We've caught this twice now by manually auditing folder access each month, which isn't sustainable but works well enough that we've built it into our onboarding checklist. No urgent need to escalate, just flagging in case it's a known limitation rather than something specific to our setup.

subject: Dashboard is great - small question
body: Really pleased with the new finance dashboard layout. Quick question: can we pin a tile to always show YTD regardless of the date filter?

subject: Export formatting request
body: Would it be possible to keep row height consistent in Excel exports? Small thing but makes the board pack look tidier.

subject: Export - thank you
body: The row height fix works well, thanks. One more small ask: could we get page breaks aligned to department sections in the export?

subject: Feature request - saved filter sets
body: Would love the ability to save a set of filters as a preset in report builder rather than reapplying them each month.

subject: Export - scheduled to multiple recipients
body: Can scheduled exports go to a distribution list rather than one email address? Currently I forward it manually every week.

subject: Saved filter presets - following up
body: Checking in on the saved filter presets request from October, even a basic version would help a lot ahead of our next budget cycle.

subject: Dashboard drill-down - great addition
body: The new drill-down feature on dashboards is excellent. Genuinely means we've stopped pulling anything into Excel for the monthly review now, which is exactly what we hoped for when we signed up.

subject: Dashboard tile alignment on wide screens
body: Small cosmetic thing, tiles don't align properly on our ultrawide monitors in the boardroom, leaves an odd gap on the right. Not urgent at all, just flagging for whenever.

subject: Dashboard load times
body: Dashboards are noticeably slower to load than they were a few months ago. We evaluated Storsund BI briefly last year and one of the reasons we stayed was speed, so this is worth getting ahead of.

subject: Alert rule limit reached
body: Trying to add a new alert rule and getting a message that we've hit some kind of limit. Is that tied to our plan tier?

subject: Connector missing a source type
body: We need a connector for our new logistics system and it's not in the current list. Storsund BI apparently supports it natively, is it something Kataja could add?

subject: Connector - following up
body: Any update on the logistics connector we asked about in December? Happy to help test if there's a beta version.

subject: Seat transfer between departments
body: Need to move three seats from operations to logistics without losing their saved dashboards. What's the process?

subject: Report builder - formula support
body: Would be useful if report builder supported basic formulas like Excel does, right now we export to do any calculation beyond a sum, which adds an extra step every time.

subject: New starter seats - can we get 4 added?
body: Hi team, we're onboarding four new analysts this week and need seats added under our Professional plan. Could you set them up with the same permissions as the rest of the finance group? Thanks in advance.

subject: Configuring an alert on connector failures
body: We'd like to set up an alert that pings us if the nightly connector sync fails - is that something Alerts can already do, or do we need a workaround? Appreciate the quick help as always.

subject: API rate limit increase for reporting batch job
body: Our nightly batch job is starting to bump against the API rate limit as we've added more dashboards. Would it be possible to raise our limit, or is there a recommended way to batch the calls? Not urgent, just want to plan ahead.

subject: Scheduling exports to land in SharePoint instead of email
body: Right now our scheduled exports land in inboxes, which gets messy with four new users on the list. Any way to point them at a SharePoint folder instead? Nice to have, no rush on this one.

subject: Quick thanks, plus a formatting question
body: Reports have looked great since the seat additions in the autumn - thanks for the smooth support all year. One small thing: can we set a default currency format across a report so we don't reformat each column by hand?

subject: Dashboard load times - noticeably better
body: Just wanted to flag that dashboard load times have improved a lot since the last update - the finance team noticed without me saying anything. One question: can we pin a specific view as the default landing page per user group?

subject: API question - webhook for report completion
body: Is there a webhook or callback we can hook into when a scheduled report finishes generating? Would let us trigger a Slack notification instead of polling. Everything else is running smoothly on our end.

subject: Dashboard not loading for some users
body: Hi, a couple of our users are getting a blank screen when trying to open the main operations dashboard. Other dashboards work fine. Their permissions look correct. Could you take a look? Maja Korhonen.

subject: Dashboard — can we set a default date range for all users?
body: Hello, we'd like the date filter on our dashboards to default to 'current month' for all users instead of 'last 7 days'. Is there a way to set this globally per dashboard, or is it per-user only? Thanks, Maja.

subject: Report with cross-dataset join — how to set up
body: We need to build a report that combines data from two different connectors. Is it possible to do a join across data sources in the Report builder, or does this need to happen at the connector level first? If the latter, any guidance on the recommended approach would be appreciated.

subject: Dashboard widgets broken after update
body: After last night's platform update, two widgets on our main dashboard are showing errors. One says 'data source unavailable' and the other just shows a blank space. Nothing changed on our side. This dashboard is used in our weekly management meeting tomorrow — please fix urgently. Maja Korhonen.

subject: Dashboard still showing errors — widgets not recovered
body: The widgets that broke after the update last week are still not showing correctly for some users even after the fix you applied. One user in particular still sees 'data source unavailable'. This is getting disruptive — our reporting depends on this dashboard. Can someone look at it again specifically for that user's session? Maja.

subject: API calls timing out — integration broken
body: Our API-based data pull has started timing out consistently. Requests that used to complete in 2–3 seconds are now hanging for 30+ seconds before failing. This is affecting our nightly data load. We've had ongoing dashboard issues for the past two weeks and now this. I need a proper response with a timeline, not just acknowledgement. Maja Korhonen.

subject: Report builder completely broken — can't open any reports
body: Report builder is not loading at all. Clicking on any report gives a white screen. This is now the third separate module with issues in a month. Our team has basically stopped trying to use the platform. I expect this to be treated as urgent — we have deliverables that depend on this. Maja.

subject: API timeouts still happening — no resolution from last ticket
body: Still getting API timeouts. The last ticket on this was opened three weeks ago and I haven't had a satisfactory resolution. Our nightly data load has failed every night. This is not a small inconvenience — it means reports are running on stale data. I need escalation.

subject: Report builder broken again
body: Report builder stopped working again. Same white screen as before. I was told this was fixed. Clearly it wasn't. Our team has given up using it and we're building workarounds in other tools. Someone senior needs to own this.

subject: Export function not working
body: Exports are failing. I'll be honest — I'm not sure it's worth going into detail at this point. Please look into it and let me know when it's fixed. Maja Korhonen.

subject: Report builder — calculated field error on load
body: Logging this for completeness. Calculated field in one of our standard reports throws an error on load. Workaround is to open the field editor and close it without changing anything — that clears the error for the session. Just noting it. Maja.

subject: Dashboard date filter issue
body: Date filter on the main dashboard defaulting to wrong range again. Please fix. Maja.

subject: Export — column order different from report view
body: Export column order doesn't match the report view. Minor, but worth logging. Maja Korhonen.

subject: Report builder - nested filter not applying correctly
body: When we nest a filter inside a group filter in Report Builder, the inner condition seems to get ignored and the report returns all rows regardless. Can you check whether this is expected behaviour or a bug? Happy to send the report ID.

subject: Report builder - date range picker defaults to wrong fiscal year
body: Our fiscal year starts in April, but the date range picker in Report Builder still defaults to calendar year. Is there a setting to change this, or do we need to adjust manually each time? Same spirit as the filter issue back in November, just a smaller nuisance.

subject: Nightly sync failing - dashboards showing yesterday's numbers
body: Nightly connector sync has failed two nights running. Finance is looking at stale numbers this morning. Need this fixed today.

subject: Alerts didn't fire on the failed sync
body: Related to the sync outage - we have an alert configured for failed syncs and it never fired. What's the point of the alert if it doesn't alert?

subject: Reports built on yesterday's broken sync are wrong
body: Because the sync was broken, half our saved reports pulled garbage numbers overnight. Had to manually flag this to the board before the meeting. Not a good look.

subject: Export button greyed out, no explanation

subject: Dashboards finally back but slow to load

subject: Export to Excel corrupting file again

subject: Dashboard widget missing after refresh

subject: Re: Dashboard widget missing - now two more gone
body: Update - two more widgets have vanished since I sent the last ticket an hour ago. Whatever's happening, it's spreading.

subject: Re: widgets disappearing - all fixed?

subject: API calls timing out since yesterday's dashboard issue

subject: Locked out of admin console

subject: Seat count wrong on invoice again

subject: Scheduled export didn't send Friday

subject: Re: scheduled export - report builder crashed while running it manually

subject: API key rotation broke our integration

subject: API throttling far below documented limit

subject: Connector auth token expiring early

subject: Admin permissions reverted overnight

subject: Re: API 500s - now consistent, not intermittent

subject: Can't reset a user's password during the API outage

subject: Year-end API load - calls dropping
body: Higher volume than usual for year-end reporting and we're seeing dropped calls. Same integration, nothing changed on our end.

subject: Dashboard export button missing on shared view
body: The export button has disappeared from the shared year-end dashboard view specifically - works fine on my own copy. Need this before Friday's close.

subject: Alert emails going to spam folder
body: Our alert notification emails keep landing in spam instead of the inbox. Could you check the sending domain configuration, or advise what SPF/DKIM records we should add on our side?

subject: Need to add two seats for new hires in finance
body: We have two new starters joining the finance team next month and need seats provisioned under Admin & Seats. Could you also copy the permission set from our existing controllers?

subject: Seat permissions not matching what was requested
body: The two new seats from earlier this month went live but with viewer-only access rather than the controller permission set we asked for. Could someone adjust this when you get a chance?

subject: New connector setup for reporting on a second ERP instance
body: We've brought a second ERP instance online for our newly acquired subsidiary and need a data connector set up against it. Can you send over the requirements, or should we schedule a call to walk through it?

subject: Connector sync interval - can it be changed?
body: Is it possible to change our connector sync from every six hours to hourly? We're finding the lag noticeable when we check dashboards mid-morning.

subject: Scheduled export missing header row
body: The scheduled CSV export that goes to our warehouse team is coming through without the header row this week - previously it always included one. Can you check if something changed on the template?

subject: API documentation for new authentication method
body: We're rebuilding our integration and noticed the API docs mention a new authentication method but no example. Could you point us to sample code, or is the old API key method still supported?

subject: Second question on the new API auth - token expiry
body: Quick follow-up to May's question - once we're on the new auth method, how long do tokens stay valid before needing a refresh? Want to make sure our scheduled jobs don't silently fail overnight.

subject: Bulk seat import via CSV - possible?
body: We're onboarding a large batch of new users ahead of go-live and would like to import seats via CSV rather than adding them one by one. Does Admin & Seats support this?

subject: Re: bulk seat import - CSV template errors
body: Tried the CSV import approach - about a dozen rows failed with a generic 'invalid format' error though the fields look correct to us. Can you check what the importer expects for the role column?

subject: Connector to new data warehouse - schema mapping
body: We've migrated to a new data warehouse and need to remap our existing connector to the new schema rather than starting from scratch. Is that something support can assist with, or is it self-service?

subject: API access for an internal tool running alongside Kataja
body: One of our teams is piloting an internal tool that needs read access to our data via API, used alongside Kataja rather than instead of it. Can you confirm the API supports read-only scoped keys?

subject: Export template needs updating for new fiscal categories
body: We've added new fiscal categories this year and our standard export template doesn't include the new columns. Can this be adjusted, or do we need to build a new template ourselves?

subject: API scoped key from January still showing full access
body: The read-only scoped key we set up back in January for the internal tool appears to have full write access based on what our security review just found. Could you confirm the scoping is actually being enforced?

subject: Export template question - can columns be reordered by user?
body: Following on from the fiscal category update in April, could individual users reorder columns in their own export view, or is the template fixed account-wide?
